subject: SolarWind: Marketplace co-sell demo — scheduling + recording ownership
body:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@solarwind.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SolarWind: Marketplace co-sell demo — scheduling + recording ownership

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the interest in a joint marketplace demo. To make the session useful for the AWS listing and the SI pack we typically:
- run a 30-minute technical walkthrough (20m demo + 10m Q&A)
- capture a short recording we can share with the marketplace listing (will ask for permissions)
- surface an ops runbook so both sides know roles during the live demo

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Tue 2026-08-10 10:00–10:30
- Wed 2026-08-11 14:00–14:30

Can you confirm which works for SolarWind and whether Tom (SI lead) can join? If neither, send two alternatives and we’ll try to accommodate. I attached a short runbook and a 30-minute agenda to this thread.

Attachments: redwood-cosell-runbook-v1.pdf (ops notes), demo-agenda-30min.md (agenda)

Also quick question: are you comfortable with Redwood owning the recording for the listing (we’ll share edited highlights and credit SolarWind), or does SolarWind prefer to own the raw footage? Either approach is fine — we just need to know for the marketplace submission and any internal approvals.

Next steps: confirm slot, confirm recording owner, and we’ll send calendar invite + DocuSign MOU for co-marketing.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai

----

From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@solarwind.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-02T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SolarWind: Marketplace co-sell demo — scheduling + recording ownership

Jonas —

Thanks for the clear options. Wanted to loop Tom (SI lead) into the thread so he can weigh in on technical prep. Tom, are you able to join either proposed slot? We do have a deadline for our internal approvals this week, so earlier is better.

Quick notes from our side:
- The SI team prefers demos between 08:00–11:00 PDT; the Wed 14:00 slot is tough for us.
- Because this will be used on the AWS listing, our security team wants a short sign-off on the recording and the final slide deck.
- We will likely ask to own the raw recording; allow Redwood to produce a highlights clip for the listing (SolarWind approval required).

Proposed alternatives (PDT):
- Tue 2026-08-10 08:30–09:00
- Fri 2026-08-13 10:00–10:30

Attaching SolarWind demo checklist (internal) — please treat as internal.

Sarah Liu
Head of Partnerships
SolarWind
sarah.liu@solarwind.com

Attachment: solarwind-demo-checklist.xlsx (internal)

----

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@solarwind.com>, Tom Park <tom.park@sysintegrators.io>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, MarketplaceOps <marketplace.ops@aws-partner.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SolarWind: Marketplace co-sell demo — scheduling + recording ownership

Thanks Sarah — and hi Tom, welcome to the thread.

We can do Tue 2026-08-10 at 08:30 PDT (that slot works on our side) — I’ve tentatively held it until I get confirmation from you both. Notes and proposed flow:
- Owner of raw recording: SolarWind (per your note). Redwood will produce a 60–90 second highlights clip for the marketplace listing and share the edit for approval 24 hours before publishing.
- Runbook roles: Redwood will handle model runtime / prompt walkthrough; SolarWind SI will cover integration and deployment considerations.
- Deliverables before demo: final slide deck (PDF), short security checklist clearance (signed by SolarWind security contact), and signed co-marketing MOU.

I created a DocuSign envelope for the MOU (link below) so legal can sign quickly — it’s standard co-marketing wording (no revenue share). If SolarWind prefers its own contract, we can accommodate but it will slow timeline.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign/req-2345
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/6472

If Tom confirms, I’ll send the calendar invite and upload the runbook/agenda to the shared drive.

—Jonas

----

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@solarwind.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T16:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SolarWind: Marketplace co-sell demo — scheduling + recording ownership

Jonas / Sarah — confirmed from Redwood CS: 08:30 PDT on 2026-08-10 is good for our host and tech ops. We will own pre-demo tech checks 30 minutes before the slot.

Kimberly Park
Customer Success Lead, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

----

(End of thread)
